title: Deep Ritz Physics-Informed Neural Network Method for Solving the Variational Inequality
summary: Variational inequalities are widely applied in mechanical engineering, fluid penetration, transportation, and other fields. In this paper, a Deep Ritz method based on Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) is proposed to enhance the accuracy and efficiency of solving elliptic variational inequalities. The Ritz variational method is firstly utilized to transform the variational inequality problem into an optimization problem.
